analysis_scope: Descriptive analysis of frozen saved outputs; no benchmark-based model fitting, scale selection or additional OCR

uncertainty.external: 2000 source-document bootstrap resamples, seed0; separate task/split; no multiplicity correction
uncertainty.benchmark_interval_reason: The frozen benchmark manifest and GT metadata contain no authoritative document-group mapping. No independence-assuming page bootstrap or per-page Overall was constructed.

limitations: The external training pool has only180 regions; validation/test each48; scientific-paper source domain.
External fixed-scale test means exceeded both learned families; most paired source-document intervals included zero.
Output changes are not automatically quality improvements; ambiguous native-to-official correspondence stays unmatchable.
No full-set fixed-scale counterfactual; end-to-end gains cannot isolate learning from rereading.
Controller families differ in more than continuity; integer resizing, detection and OCR remain outside continuity claims.
Requested upstream OCR model revision unverified; actual runtime files pinned by hashes.
No benchmark-based fitting, tuning, arm selection or failed-page replay; all six frozen outputs retained.
